observer.first_path_policy: first index of strongest Rx with magnitude >= 0.3*largest peak, SAME n0 for both Rx ports

model.name: SourceFFD
model.rx_rotation: yaw_body_rad + mount_deg_rad; TX0 +45 already in bank, do NOT double subtract
model.field_orientation: RX^T TX co-vector contraction (no unintended Hermitian conjugation)
model.complex_channel: frequency-dependent complex E-fields, actual estimated range for s prediction, direct-only
model.north_pole_cap: source-only Taylor cap 1 and 3 degree rings; reserved 2-degree validation; 0.1 to 0.5 degree smooth blend
model.h_s: source complex first-path signed dual port power ratio
model.J_s: analytic within fixed FFD interpolation cell and first-path tap; report crossings

baseline.baseline_compare: old LUT vs SourceFFD on identical raw H, exact pose, same r,z,extraction; only h_s/J_s change
baseline.warning: Rrs=0 is a conventional unverified assumption; not physical independence

offline_truth_only_estimands.multipath_s_contrast: z_s_FULL-z_s_NATIVE_LOS matched same case,pose and observer; NOT independent stochastic noise
offline_truth_only_estimands.sample_covariance: unbiased ddof=1 over (e_r_m,e_s) after per-stratum mean subtraction; units [m^2,m,1]

populations.characteristics: 7 C0 cases × paired H Full+NativeLoS, 9519 pose-case keys each (19038 measurements)
populations.temporal_slice: 7 C0 cases 7251 common time-case-steps each channel (14502 entries)
populations.eval_slice: t>=30 s gives 6201 common steps per channel; used for comparability but no filter score in P1
populations.source_roles: retrospective only; all C0 dev histories; no external holdout claim
